retrievalProfile.description: A raw, high-contrast neo-expressionist portrait featuring a dark silhouette with spray-painted clown features and dripping red accents against a vibrant red background.
triggerTerms: dripping red paint on black silhouette

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black silhouette of a figure in a wide-brimmed hat, set against a textured, saturated red background. The face is defined by crude, spray-painted elements: white eyes with black pupils, a red nose, a wide white mouth with individual teeth, and dripping red lines suggesting a smile or blood. A white question mark with drips sits to the left, and a small white dagger icon is centered on the hat.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black silhouette against a saturated red field
Crude white spray-painted facial features layered over black
Vertical paint drips connecting facial elements to the lower torso
Symbolic white icons (dagger, question mark) framing the central figure
coreInvariants: Saturated red background with visible texture
Matte black silhouette of a hatted figure
Dripping red and white spray paint effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central bust-up silhouette occupying 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white spray-painted mouth and teeth in the center of the silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the white question mark on the left, across to the eyes, down the dripping red lines to the white collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vibrant red background provides active negative space that pushes the silhouette forward.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high saturation in the red mid-tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured, saturated red background with a large matte black silhouette of a man in a wide-brimmed hat and suit. Add a white question mark with drips on the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply crude spray-paint effects for the face: white eyes, a red nose, and a wide white mouth with teeth. Add dripping red lines from the nose and mouth, and a small white dagger icon on the hat.

verificationChecks: Ensure the red background is vibrant and textured
Check that the white paint has visible spray-mist edges
Verify the presence of vertical drips from the red and white elements

mustRedesign: Avoid clean lines or digital gradients
Do not use standard fonts for the icons
Ensure the silhouette remains a flat, dark mass

mustAchieve: Raw, tactile texture of spray paint

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical painting?
Is the contrast between the black silhouette and red background sharp?
Are the drips convincing and gravity-aligned?
Is the white paint sufficiently opaque against the black?
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a matte black silhouette to a textured red field, then layer crude, dripping white and red spray-painted symbols to define a face and surrounding icons.
